summary: Builds a results page menu for a race-results list. Walks the linked list rooted at dword_7D2DC0 (head copied into dword_7D2DC8), skips any entry whose path matches the settings file path (dword_7CE5EC or byte_5EA438), and for each surviving entry records the track name (looked up under aTrackname in the season-races section) plus the race number and a lap time formatted as minutes:seconds. The assembled strings are emitted as UI menu items via UIMenuItemCreator with column headers retrieved by UIListIndexedAccessor(1) and (2). ABI label Results_Page_Builder is LEGACY-only and unverified.

operations.description: Initialize locals: seed the header byte v18 from byte_5EA438[0], and seed the three wide buffers v24/v23/v22 with word_5C694C followed by zero-fill (memset sizes 60 and 30 bytes).
Perform page-scope state cleanup by calling StateCleanupNotification(this) before building.
Start the result walk: dword_7D2DC8 = dword_7D2DC0 (list head), and read the first entry pointer from the head node.
Iterate the race-results list through the node link pointer (second dword of each entry), updating the walker global dword_7D2DC8 each step, until the link chain terminates.

Per entry, compare the entry path (string at the node, or byte_5EA438 when null) against the settings path (dword_7CE5EC, or byte_5EA438 when null) via sub_588410; entries that match are skipped for result formatting.
For a surviving entry, locate its season-races section with SeasonRacesSectionFinder on the entry path.

If the section was found, copy the entry path into the v24 track buffer with sub_587DD0 (bound 0x3F), null its tail, then search for the aTrackname key with StringKeyedLinkedListSearch and overwrite the buffer with the matching value via DataEntryAccessor when present.
Format the race number into v22 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using "%d" on the entry dword at offset 16.

Read the lap time float at entry offset 20, truncate it to an integer with CRTFtol, then split into whole minutes (divide by 60) and a remainder, reducing the float by the minute part when at least one minute is present.
Format the lap time into v23 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using "%i:%06.3f" on the minutes value and the remainder.
Refresh the header buffer length with StrlenOverwrite(&v18) after the string writes.
Build a title text into v26 from byte_5EA438 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and create the UI menu item with UIMenuItemCreator(this, v26, 0, 0, 0, 0).
Emit column header 1: read label 1 with UIListIndexedAccessor(this, 1), concatenate label + header + race number via "%s%s%s" into v26, and create the menu item.
Emit column header 2: read label 2 with UIListIndexedAccessor(this, 2), concatenate label + header + lap time via "%s%s%s" into v26, and create the menu item.
Return the result of the final UIMenuItemCreator call.
